metrics.query: cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'brightwater-networks' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2023-10-07T12:00:00.000Z, 2025-10-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions -> containers.cna.problemTypes[].descriptions[].cweId (placeholders counted: true)

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'brightwater-networks' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2023-10-07T12:00:00.000Z, 2025-10-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions AND has_wellformed_cna_cpe -> cpe.vendor IN cpe_vendor_aliases('brightwater-networks') = [brightwater]
